summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a binding C$20 million investment agreement with the Government of Canada under the Strategic Response Fund for its battery-grade cobalt sulfate refinery. The funding is non-dilutive government support for construction and commissioning, with no per-share price, premium, or ownership stake. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The agreement converts prior tentative support into a firm commitment. Watch for project milestones and continued government backing; there is no risk-arb angle as this is not a transactional special situation but a project financing event.
